Deciding
to
go
to

school

perhaps

simplest
part
of
what
can
be
a
complicated
process
.
With
nearly
600
accredited
MBA
programmes
on
offer
around
the
world

the
choice
of
where
to
study
can
be
overwhelming
.
Here
we
explain
how
to
choose
the
right
school
and
course
for
you
and

and

process
